id: AT-AP-26 (a carried line that cites a moved id keeps its carried-stamp exemption)
note: A line carried byte-identical from the own file keeps an old `checked <stamp>` (lint exempts carried lines from unprinted-time and time-format). When an approval it cites moves to Open questions, publish rewrites its U-<k> to the new Q-<m>; that rewrite alone does not make it a new line, so the re-lint of the moved text still exempts it and publish writes the file, as round 1 did. A line that is not carried, with the same old stamp and the same moved id, still blocks: the first publish refuses with LINT unprinted-time for it; without it the handoff is written with the carried line rewritten.
